items.stem: Explain why human rights are difficult to enforce internationally.

items.stem: Outline two points that could be used to evaluate the claim: "The Universal Declaration of Human Rights has been effective in protecting human rights."

items.stem: Distinguish between civil and political rights and economic, social and cultural rights.
